bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, a 19-year-old named Prashanth was murdered by friends and buried at a beach, and the office should monitor the police investigation.
Two women died in separate bus crashes near Puzhal and Nazarethpet in Chennai, and the office must watch the traffic investigation units' actions against the drivers.
The Greater Chennai Corporation approved biomining and maintenance resolutions while keeping a land gift deed in abeyance, and the office should watch project rollouts.
Plastic waste accumulated in the Taramani Pelli Amman temple tank is causing a stench, and the office should direct local bodies to clear the pond immediately.
The BJP took action regarding temple land and roads in Velachery around the Dhandeeswaram Temple, and the office should monitor local political developments.
Two accused in a petty shop owner murder case were detained under the Goondas Act in Thiruvallur, and the office should track law and order enforcement.
A sudden power cut interrupted DMDK leader Premalatha Vijayakanth's press meet in Thiruvallur, and the office should watch local grid reliability.
A POCSO court sentenced a youth to 22 years in prison for sexually abusing a minor girl, and the office should support victim assistance measures.
The Tamil Nadu government rolled out a Rs 125 crore scheme for AI assistive devices for persons with disabilities, and the office should oversee implementation.
CapitaLand launched a data centre in Ambattur providing 53 MW of gross power capacity, and the office should monitor digital infrastructure investments.
OneQode and AdaniConneX agreed on a 14MW AI capacity deal in Siruseri Sipcot, and the office should watch for further AI hub expansions.
